_comment: Zod schema drift baseline between lib/api/schemas.ts and lib/api/schemas/* (#1883, #2819). Until #2819 the MONOLITH was canonical and the submodule copies were the drifted second ones; #2819 deleted the 135 copies the monolith carried, so each schema now has ONE definition in its domain module under lib/api/schemas/* and lib/api/schemas.ts imports and re-exports it. The guard (scripts/check-schema-drift.mjs) now fails on any name defined in BOTH places, identical body or not, so there is nothing left to grandfather: this baseline is EMPTY and an entry here only delays the ratchet it documents. Do not add entries back without a documented reason.
